examples.supplier:
rule "Prepare supplier data":
  rename `Unit Price` to price
  convert price to number
  convert quantity to integer
  set total to price * quantity

rule "Valid price":
  check price is required
  check price is a number
  check price is between 0 and 10000
  message "Enter a numeric price from 0 to 10000"

rule "Supported country":
  check country is in ["US", "CA", "MX"]
  message "Country must be US, CA or MX"
examples.quoted-fields:
rule "Read exact column headers":
  convert `Unit Price` to number
  convert quantity to integer
  set total to `Unit Price` * quantity
  set `Customer Note` to "Reviewed"
examples.checks:
rule "Valid price":
  check price is required
  check price is a number
  check price is between 0 and 10000
  message "Enter a numeric price from 0 to 10000"
examples.conditional:
rule "Discount on larger orders":
  when price is greater than 100
  check discount is a number
  check discount is at least 0
  message "Discount must be a nonnegative number"
examples.privacy:
rule "Remove identifying fields":
  anonymize email, phone, `Full Name`
examples.missing:
rule "Supply a missing note":
  when note is missing or note is null
  set note to "Not provided"

en.title: Rename a field
en.description: Change a field name without changing its value. Backticks reference an exact CSV header containing spaces.

es.title: Renombrar un campo
es.description: Cambia el nombre sin alterar el valor. Las comillas invertidas indican el nombre exacto de una columna con espacios.

entries.code:
rule "Rename a column":
  rename `Unit Price` to price

en.title: Split a field
en.description: Split a string using a literal separator. The number of parts must match the destination fields.

es.title: Dividir un campo
es.description: Divide un texto por un separador literal. El número de partes debe coincidir con los campos de destino.
es.parameters: campo de origen, campos de destino, separador

entries.code:
rule "Split a name":
  split full_name into first_name, last_name by " "

en.title: Merge fields
en.description: Join string fields in the written order using an explicit separator.

es.title: Combinar campos
es.description: Une campos de texto en el orden escrito con un separador explícito.
es.parameters: campos de origen, campo de destino, separador

entries.code:
rule "Build a full name":
  merge first_name, last_name into full_name with " "

en.title: Map values
en.description: Replace a value using a map with quoted text keys. An unmapped value fails the record instead of silently passing through.

es.title: Mapear valores
es.description: Sustituye un valor mediante un mapa con claves de texto entre comillas. Un valor sin correspondencia produce un error en el registro.

entries.code:
rule "Expand country codes":
  map country_code using {"US": "United States", "CA": "Canada", "MX": "Mexico"}

en.title: Convert a type
en.description: Convert a field explicitly. CSV cells start as strings; checks never convert them implicitly. Invalid conversions fail the record.
en.parameters: field, number / integer / string / boolean / date

es.title: Convertir un tipo
es.description: Convierte un campo explícitamente. Las celdas CSV empiezan como textos; las comprobaciones no las convierten de forma implícita. Una conversión inválida produce un error.
es.parameters: campo, number / integer / string / boolean / date

entries.code:
rule "Read a quantity":
  convert quantity to integer

en.title: Set or calculate a field
en.description: Assign a literal, copy a field or evaluate an expression. Expressions are not quoted.

es.title: Asignar o calcular un campo
es.description: Asigna un literal, copia un campo o evalúa una expresión. Las expresiones no llevan comillas.

entries.code:
rule "Calculate a total":
  set total to price * quantity

en.title: Normalize text
en.description: Use set with a text function. The same assignment form works for lowercase, uppercase, titlecase and trim.

es.title: Normalizar texto
es.description: Usa set con una función de texto. La misma asignación sirve para lowercase, uppercase, titlecase y trim.

entries.code:
rule "Normalize a name":
  set name to lowercase(name)

en.title: Replace a value
en.description: Replace an exact typed value in a field. Replacing null does not replace an absent field or an empty string.

es.title: Sustituir un valor
es.description: Sustituye un valor exacto y del mismo tipo. Reemplazar null no reemplaza un campo ausente ni un texto vacío.

entries.code:
rule "Replace a null status":
  replace null with "N/A" in status

en.title: Round a number
en.description: Use round inside an assignment. Decimal ties round away from zero, so results do not depend on a runtime default.

es.title: Redondear un número
es.description: Usa round dentro de una asignación. Los empates decimales se redondean alejándose de cero para evitar diferencias entre motores.

entries.code:
rule "Round a price":
  set price to round(price, 2)

en.title: Mask a value
en.description: Replace a field value with the supplied constant. Masking changes its display but does not establish dataset anonymity.

es.title: Enmascarar un valor
es.description: Sustituye el valor por la constante indicada. El enmascaramiento cambia su presentación, pero no demuestra que el conjunto sea anónimo.

entries.code:
rule "Mask email":
  mask email with "****@domain.com"

en.title: Remove identifying fields
en.description: Anonymize explicitly named fields by removing them from the working data and output. This does not detect all PII or assess re-identification risk.

es.title: Eliminar campos identificativos
es.description: Anonymize elimina los campos indicados de los datos de trabajo y de la salida. No detecta toda la información personal ni evalúa el riesgo de reidentificación.

entries.code:
rule "Remove direct identifiers":
  anonymize email, phone, `Full Name`

en.title: Drop fields
en.description: Remove fields that are no longer needed. Use anonymize to express the intent to remove identifying fields.

es.title: Eliminar campos
es.description: Elimina campos que ya no hacen falta. Usa anonymize para expresar la intención de retirar campos identificativos.

entries.code:
rule "Drop a temporary field":
  drop temp_field

en.title: Fill missing values
en.description: Fill absent or null values with a literal or aggregate. Empty strings stay distinct. Mean and median use a snapshot of retained rows at the start of the rule.

es.title: Rellenar valores ausentes
es.description: Rellena valores ausentes o null con un literal o agregado. Los textos vacíos siguen siendo distintos. Mean y median usan una instantánea de las filas conservadas al empezar la regla.

entries.code:
rule "Fill an absent age":
  fill age with mean(age)

en.title: Reorder columns
en.description: List every retained field exactly once to set CSV output order. For JSON this only controls serialization order.

es.title: Reordenar columnas
es.description: Enumera una vez cada campo conservado para definir el orden de salida CSV. En JSON solo afecta al orden de serialización.
es.parameters: todos los campos conservados, en orden

entries.code:
rule "Order output columns":
  reorder columns id, name, email

en.title: Keep matching rows
en.description: Keep rows for which the condition is true. Other rows are counted as filtered, not as failed checks. A prior failure cannot be erased by a later filter.

es.title: Conservar filas que cumplen
es.description: Conserva las filas cuya condición es verdadera. Las demás se cuentan como filtradas, no como validaciones fallidas. Un filtro posterior no borra un fallo previo.

entries.code:
rule "Keep adult records":
  keep rows where age is at least 18

en.title: Required values
en.description: Reject absent fields, null, empty or whitespace-only strings, and empty collections. Zero and false are present values.

es.title: Valores obligatorios
es.description: Rechaza campos ausentes, null, textos vacíos o con solo espacios y colecciones vacías. Cero y false son valores presentes.

entries.code:
rule "A name is required":
  check name is required
  message "Name is required"

en.title: Data types
en.description: Check a type without converting it. Use a number, an integer, a string, a boolean or a date. Dates are valid ISO YYYY-MM-DD strings.

es.title: Tipos de datos
es.description: Comprueba el tipo sin convertirlo. Usa a number, an integer, a string, a boolean o a date. Las fechas son textos ISO YYYY-MM-DD válidos.

entries.code:
rule "Age is numeric":
  check age is a number
  message "Age must be numeric"

en.title: Ranges
en.description: Check an inclusive numeric range: both the lower and upper bounds are allowed.

es.title: Rangos
es.description: Comprueba un rango numérico inclusivo: se admiten ambos límites.

entries.code:
rule "A price is in range":
  check price is between 0 and 10000
  message "Price must be between 0 and 10000"

en.title: Membership
en.description: Check exact, case-sensitive typed membership. Use is not in to exclude a list.

es.title: Pertenencia a una lista
es.description: Comprueba pertenencia exacta, sensible a mayúsculas y al tipo. Usa is not in para excluir una lista.

entries.code:
rule "Country is supported":
  check country is in ["US", "CA", "MX"]
  message "Country must be US, CA or MX"

en.title: Minimum values
en.description: Use is greater than for an exclusive threshold and is at least for an inclusive threshold.

es.title: Valores mínimos
es.description: Usa is greater than para un límite exclusivo e is at least para uno inclusivo.

entries.code:
rule "Discount is positive":
  check discount is greater than 0
  check price is at least 0

en.title: Maximum values
en.description: Use is less than for an exclusive threshold and is at most for an inclusive threshold.

es.title: Valores máximos
es.description: Usa is less than para un límite exclusivo e is at most para uno inclusivo.

entries.code:
rule "Discount is within its limit":
  check age is less than 18
  check discount is at most 50

en.title: Equality and exclusion
en.description: Use is or is not for equality, and is not in to exclude values. Fields, strings and numbers remain distinct.

es.title: Igualdad y exclusión
es.description: Usa is o is not para igualdad, e is not in para excluir valores. Campos, textos y números se mantienen distintos.

entries.code:
rule "Status is active":
  check status is "Active"
  check status is not in ["Inactive", "Suspended"]
